role: Bounded implementation hardening of the existing C163 raw-IQ two-GPU path; no new scheduler, deadline, workload, or service class.

hypotheses_in_order.hypothesis: A persistent Fortran complex input removes per-request complex allocation while retaining the pre-CE host synchronization.
hypotheses_in_order.decision: Mechanism ablation only; cannot qualify or open a holdout.

hypotheses_in_order.hypothesis: The persistent buffer plus the already-correct cuPHY stream dependency removes the redundant pre-CE host synchronization.
hypotheses_in_order.decision: Exactly 1000/1000 correct pair completions <=4.5 ms opens one disjoint-seed holdout; any late or incorrect completion rejects the candidate.
Exactly 1000/1000 correct pair completions <=4.5 ms qualifies this finite-sample mode; any late or incorrect completion rejects it.

stop_rules: Do not open the holdout unless the fixed development gate passes.
Do not change the 4.5-ms threshold, warmup, workload, seed, iteration count, or correctness rule after observing results.
Preserve every raw result and failure; do not rerun with a different seed to replace a failure.
If H2 fails, the candidate is rejected and the remaining CE tail stays an explicit production gap; profiling may diagnose but cannot qualify it.
